references.text: The repetition of the motif 'to put everything in his hand' shows God's constant blessing and Joseph's leadership qualities across different life situations.
Confirmation that 'the Lord was with Joseph' is the underlying cause of his leadership both in the house and in prison.
Clear connection between God's blessing (cause) and the human trust/responsibility Joseph receives (effect).
Demonstration of the principle in 39:5 (blessing over everything Joseph touches) as it is concretely fulfilled in the prison in 39:22.
The psalm refers directly to the event in Genesis 39 and confirms that God's hand was with Joseph by giving him favor with the prison warden.
